Six records, each carrying exactly one thing `tests/validation-records.test.mjs` refuses, so that
every pattern is proved to fire on its own. Nothing here is real: the host is the documentation
placeholder, the address is `example.com`, the sys_id is thirty-two `a`s, the home path is a
made-up user. A fixture that had to contain a real leak to test for leaks would be the defect.
